Chasing costs 13.6 runs in the IPL — but that hides a wide spread

Across 569 matches at these grounds a first innings averages 165.8 and a chase 152.2, at 7.95 runs an over. On first-innings scoring that places the IPL 2th among the 10 T20 leagues we hold ground data for, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.

The league average is the least interesting number on this page. Chasing costs 17.2 runs at M Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru and only 3.6 at PCA IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali. The highest-scoring ground on the list is PCA IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali at 8.69 an over. A total that wins comfortably at one of these grounds loses at another.

These are T20 records for each ground rather than for this competition alone, so treat them as ground character. Sample sizes vary a lot — a ground with five matches behind it deserves far less weight than one with a hundred, and both are in the table rather than hidden behind an average. The live model does not use these figures: once a ball is bowled it reads the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern instead.

How the live prediction works

It starts when the match does. There is no pre-match tip here. Win probability is recalculated after every ball from the score, wickets in hand, balls and runs remaining, and how the pitch is behaving in this innings rather than on average.

Measured, not claimed. 81.5% win-probability accuracy on a true holdout: trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 the model had never seen. Accuracy rises through an innings, from 79.2% at over 6 to 82.2% by over 15.

Next-over forecasts too. Expected runs for the coming over land inside the published range 72.3% of the time, measured across 46,718 over-boundary snapshots.

IPL predictions — FAQs

Which IPL ground is hardest to chase at?
M Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru. Across 111 matches there, sides batting first average 170.2 and sides chasing 153.0 — a 17.2-run gap. The most forgiving is PCA IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali, where the same gap is 3.6.
What is a good score in the Indian Premier League?
Across 569 matches at the grounds listed, a first innings averages 165.8 and a chase 152.2, at 7.95 runs an over. That puts the IPL 2th of the 10 T20 leagues we track for first-innings scoring, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.
Who will win tonight's IPL match?
We do not publish pre-match tips. The model is a live model: it has nothing useful to say until a ball is bowled, and then recalculates win probability after every one from the score, wickets in hand, required rate and how the pitch is actually playing. It measures 81.5% accuracy on a true holdout — trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 it had never seen.
Where do these numbers come from?
Ball-by-ball records for the grounds this competition uses, 569 matches in total. They are T20 records for each ground rather than records for this competition alone, so read them as ground character. Sample sizes are shown per ground in the table — some are small, and a ground with 5 matches behind it deserves less weight than one with 100.
